pages: The Master came out of his rooms for the first time in a month. Someone has killed the Paladin. Not banished - killed, and taken what was left of him. He says the Paladin was a child playing with a thing he did not understand, and that the one who killed him understands even less, and carries it now, and does not know what he carries.
He says: follow the Marked One. Where he sleeps, the ground is ripe. I do not know what that means. We are leaving tonight.
